prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: landscape 16:9 game thumbnail for Wreck Yard, designed to remain clear at a small size.
Primary request: Generate a polished original thumbnail for a playful multiplayer voxel destruction game.
Scene: industrial scrap yard at sunset, dark asphalt, blocky scrap stacks, thin floodlight towers, dark factory skyline, charcoal navy sky and a vivid burnt-orange horizon.
Subjects: an orange open-cabin dune buggy with a dark roll cage and four chunky black tires, leaping off a yellow-orange metal ramp in the lower right; a compact orange scrap robot in the lower left with one wheel, one glowing camera eye and a mechanical tool arm holding a gravity gun. A teal steel voxel crate breaks into large distinct cubic chunks between them, with a bright warm impact flash and a small amount of sparks. Show one clear burst of destruction, readable shapes, strong action.
Style: graphic novel game illustration, angular low-poly voxel forms, broad flat cel-shading bands, bold dark ink outlines, clean industrial geometry. Match a retro-futuristic vector-industrial game. Crisp silhouette shapes, carefully controlled detail, no photorealistic textures.
Composition: wide cinematic 16:9 frame, close three-quarter buggy view, strong diagonal ramp-to-buggy motion, robot and crate visually secondary. Reserve a clean dark area in the upper left for the title. Keep important objects and title inside a 6% safe margin. No clutter over the title.
Text verbatim: "WRECK YARD". Only these two words. Large two-line condensed block lettering in warm bone-white with an orange offset shadow and a dark outline; readable at 320px wide. No subtitle or extra copy.
Palette: charcoal navy #141a21, dark steel gray, burnt orange #ec8a3c, mustard yellow #e8b54a, small teal accents, bone-white lettering.
Constraints: opaque background. No game HUD, buttons, crosshair, browser frame, watermark, extra logos, realistic people, or realistic military weapons. Attractive promotional illustration, not a screenshot.
